newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Oce replaces CSM in AEX index.
newsitem.headline: Oce replaces CSM in AEX index.

text.p: The Amsterdam Exchanges said on Monday shares of copier maker Oce-van der Grinten NV would be included in Amsterdam's AEX share index from February 24.
They will replace the stock of food group CSM, the exchanges said in a press release.
The index is revised every February and includes the 25 companies whose shares were most actively traded in Amsterdam during the previous three years.
The weightings of the various firms whose shares together make up the AEX index will be published on February 21 after bourse closing, the exchanges said.
From February 24, CSM's shares will be included in Amsterdam's Midcap or AMX index for medium-sized companies where it replaces Oce-van der Grinten.
Newcomers in the Midcap index are software group Baan, high-technology firm ASM Lithography and entertainment group Endemol.
The shares of sanitary ware maker Sphinx Gustavsberg, textiles group Gamma Holding and retailer Macintosh will be relegated from the Midcap index.
